_notes: District ids MUST match Catalog.DISTRICTS -- a quest names one, and a typo
there would silently orphan the quest from its region. Catalog.validate()
checks both directions: every district here is known to the code, and
every district the code knows has an entry here.
`blurb` is the one line a screen would show. `truth` is for whoever writes
the next quest set here -- it is not player-facing and does not need to

city.name: Hollowmere
city.blurb: A fog-buttoned city wrapped around a black lake, with chimney forests, canals, too many stairs and exactly the right number of rooftops.
city.truth: Built on seven older cities the way a cat sits on yesterday's newspaper — deliberately and without apology. The Mere is the black lake at its centre, and since Elspeth's murder the Mere has begun to hope, which is worse than it sounds.

thimblefield.name: Thimblefield
thimblefield.blurb: Witches' row. Elspeth's parlor is here, and so is home.
thimblefield.truth: The hub district. Quiet, respectable, full of people who mend things for a living. Ash's whole world was four streets of it until the night the kettle screamed.

wickrow.name: Wickrow
wickrow.blurb: The Chandlers' district — wax, wicks, and the smell of a hundred small flames.
wickrow.truth: Chapter 1's spine runs through here. The Chandlers' Guild is powerful, respectable and extremely interested in who has been buying beeswax in quantity.

shambles.name: The Shambles
shambles.blurb: A market maze that rearranges itself when nobody is measuring.
shambles.truth: Home of the Magpie Exchange. The best place in the city to sell something that should not be sold, and the second-best place to be robbed.

gravamen.name: Gravamen
gravamen.blurb: Court-adjacent. Undertakers, clerks, and the polite bureaucracy of death.
gravamen.truth: Where the night-side does its paperwork. The Hollow Court's reach is longest here. Post-launch district.

mereside.name: The Mereside
mereside.blurb: Drowned terraces going down into the black water, one storey at a time.
mereside.truth: Nobody has lived on the lowest three streets in living memory, which has not stopped anything from being at home there. Post-launch district.
